newsitem.title: USA: Shaw Group to form joint venture in China.
newsitem.headline: Shaw Group to form joint venture in China.

text.p: Shaw Group Inc said Monday that its Shaw Power Services Inc unit and China Baoyuan Industry and Trade Co, a subsidiary of China National Nuclear Corp, had signed a letter of intent to establish joint-venture ownership of a piping systems fabrication facility in Dalian, China.
Under the terms of the letter of intent, Shaw said its ownership and income participation in the venture is contemplated to be at least 60 percent.
The formation of the joint venture is subject to, among other things, negotiation and execution of a definitive agreement and approval by the Chinese government.
The demand for new power-generation capacity in China has created one of the world's largest power markets, Shaw said.
China plans to raise its nuclear power generation capacity by 20,000-25,000 megawatts by the year 2010, and by 40,000-50,000 megawatts by the year 2020, it said.
